summary: Committed removals always take effect, and the hybrid worker copes with protected groups and existing servers.

fixes.title: A committed removal always does its job
fixes.text: A removal committed seconds after the access was given could be cleared before it acted. It is now kept until a second check, ten minutes later, confirms nothing is left.

fixes.title: Protected AD groups no longer fail hourly
fixes.text: Groups that Active Directory protects, such as Domain Admins, keep their own name and description. The hybrid worker reports that difference instead of failing every hour; membership is unaffected.

fixes.title: Servers set up earlier are recognised
fixes.text: Discovery now says when creating a server's group adopts the group your earlier PIM for Active Directory scripts made, instead of making a new one.

fixes.title: Clearer message when the worker lacks rights
fixes.text: The hybrid worker now tells "no access" on a server apart from "unreachable", and names the exact group to add its account to.
